title: Diversity-Guided Search-Based Testing of Large Language Model Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.23209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications are increasingly deployed across domains including customer service, education, and mobility. These systems are prone to inaccurate, fictitious, or harmful responses, and their vast, high-dimensional input space makes systematic testing particularly challenging. In this paper, we present a search-based testing framework for LLM-based applications that incorporates failure diversity as an explicit optimization objective. Building on a discretization along stylistic, content-related, and perturbation dimensions, our framework maintains an archive of generated tests and rewards distance from that archive, while a repopulation operator periodically replaces non-failing tests in the population to sustain exploration. The repopulation operator is parameterized by its sampling strategy: replacement candidates are drawn either uniformly or by greedy distance maximization, two settings we compare empi

translated_title: 基于多样性引导的搜索式大语言模型应用测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的应用正日益被部署于客户服务、教育和出行等多个领域。这些系统容易产生不准确、虚构或有害的响应，且其庞大而高维的输入空间使得系统性测试尤为困难。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对基于大语言模型应用的搜索式测试框架，该框架将失败多样性作为显式的优化目标。该框架基于风格、内容和扰动三个维度上的离散化，维护一个已生成测试的存档，并奖励与该存档的距离，同时通过一个重新填充算子周期性地替换种群中未触发失败的测试，以维持探索能力。该重新填充算子由其采样策略参数化：替换候选既可以通过均匀采样获得，也可以通过贪心距离最大化获得，我们对这两种设置进行了实证比较。
tldr: 提出了一种将失败多样性作为显式优化目标的搜索式测试框架，通过维护测试存档和重新填充算子来系统性探索大语言模型应用的多样化失败。
en_tdlr: A search-based testing framework for LLM applications that explicitly optimizes for failure diversity, using a test archive and repopulation operator to systematically uncover diverse failures.
